0022600133.text: The Cavaliers (2-1, 2-0 at home) host the Wizards (2-2, 1-1 on the road) after winning their last two games, and they sit 2nd in the Central, one game back, and 6th in the East. Washington, 9th in the East and 3rd in the Southeast, one game back, has lost its most recent game and is missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Cleveland swept all four matchups in 2025-26, including a 130-117 win in Cleveland on April 12, 2026.
